closed_surface_invariants: v1.0.3 formal trace authentication treats tool_result.content and tool_use.content as payload data; fake tool_use/tool_result blocks embedded there cannot authenticate runtime lanes.
v1.0.3 strict gate thresholds count unique false-world and true-world modal tests; duplicate IDs, copied test objects, and reused canonical test evidence sets do not inflate coverage.

v1.0.3 formal trace authentication treats every tool_use/tool_result node as a hard event boundary; nested tool-like objects under data/payload/delta/message/content are payload data, not runtime events.
v1.0.3 formal trace authentication enforces assistant-origin tool_use and user-origin tool_result direction when role context is available.
v1.0.3 strict gate modal tests must have stable nonempty IDs and target the evaluated claim; duplicated, anonymous, or wrong-claim modal coverage cannot satisfy thresholds.

v1.0.3 strict gate evidence binds the NFC and whitespace-canonicalized claim proposition plus the complete canonical modal case to bounded no-follow observation-ledger bytes; coordinated proposition/case substitution, copied ledgers, malformed JSON, resource exhaustion, and invalid local paths fail closed.

v1.0.3 release provenance hygiene rejects the exact current package root plus configured stale generated-artifact, prior package/work-root, known machine-local markers, and non-UTF-8 provenance files; full prior-root text is allowed only behind the exact Historical provenance reference: line prefix.

v1.0.3 manifest update preflight preserves typed Git path/mode/object/stage evidence and rejects nonzero stages, symlink/gitlink modes, physical links, and unsupported special entries before any package write.
v1.0.3 fixed manifest paths are written through fresh same-directory temporary files and os.replace, so destination links are replaced rather than followed.
v1.0.3 live fixture PASS-SCOPED requires successful version/plugin preflight plus a structured JSON envelope whose substantive result/content report alone satisfies status, term, and artifact checks.
v1.0.3 Slice F executes every live subprocess through one resolved absolute regular target and requires stable pre/post fingerprints before PASS-SCOPED.

v1.0.3 promotion certificate schema 2.0 uses promotion-evidence-v2: the fixed nine typed canonical semantic roles form one environment-independent bounded DAG and bind distinct bundle-local regular non-symlink files by exact bytes plus SHA-256 with role-specific validation; both official-policy roles remain mandatory when unavailable execution is explicitly scope-excluded.

v1.0.3 formal result 2.0 binds the standalone endpoint-checked target copy, exact report/gate/certificate/ledger/transcript/prompt/target-snapshot companion manifest, package-tree identity, run identity, and target pre/post endpoint identity; temporal_immutability_enforced is false, so an otherwise PASS-TRACKED formal result is capped at PASS-SCOPED; promotion uses only the typed formal.result locator and allows unrelated nonreserved files.

v1.0.3 promotion recomputes the exact formal output-check projection from the bound report, certificate, ledger, and gate companions; the projection must be nonempty and all passing, so arbitrary self-attested checks and coherently rehashed empty report or gate companions fail closed.

v1.0.3 formal trace capture uses total line/node event positions, per-record depth/node bounds, pre/post endpoint identity for the source and permission-hardened execution copies, resolved runtime identity, bounded capture, and cleanup of the original process group; execution requires supported Linux PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER plus bounded /proc adopted-child tracking to be established before Popen, then kills and reaps same-group and detached-session descendants after leader exit; unavailable containment fails before execution, and incomplete cleanup or any survivor fails closed.

v1.0.3 promotion claims form a nonempty exact-typed unique-ID set; canonical strict-gate evaluation must return a nonempty all-PASS result set before promotion-strict downstream non-closure evaluation, while a performed review may explicitly identify no downstream conclusion with a substantive reason.
v1.0.3 malformed or empty promotion claims and other malformed bundle data return canonical FAIL plus failure_kind without exposing a traceback.

v1.0.3 official validator decisions and formal transcript authentication/hash/byte counts bind complete captured bytes; bounded excerpts and truncation flags are presentation metadata, capture-limit excess fails closed, and tail-only authentication is forbidden.

v1.0.3 gate Markdown, certifier JSON/Markdown, formal output and compatibility JSON, live transcripts and optional JSON, validator Markdown, gate/formal/regression/promotion contract JSON wrappers, and the fixed behavior and stable-release manifests acquire component-wise O_DIRECTORY/O_NOFOLLOW parent capabilities before their long-running work and hold them through descriptor-relative exclusive temporary or new-file creation, link/rename installation as applicable, and directory fsync. Output role and alias classifications are frozen from lexical names plus held identities; canonical formal-result classification is not recomputed after writes; certifier JSON/Markdown and live JSON/selected-transcript aliases are rejected. Each output enforces its declared fresh-versus-replaceable final-name policy; direct or ancestor links, special or hardlink sentinels, and symlink or real-directory parent substitution cannot redirect writes and fail closed. Validator Markdown additionally requires its held parent to remain outside the package tree. Formal coordinator and gate children use only runner-owned /proc/<runner-pid>/fd/N via pass_fds; procfs-visible Pid must equal the child's procfs-visible direct-parent PPid, and child-FD close/rebind, self or unrelated PIDs, noncanonical or nonpositive PID/FD tokens, extra components, closed descriptors, and file descriptors are rejected. Unavailable procfd inheritance is INVALID_INPUT before output mutation. Held-capability and endpoint checks are not temporal isolation; a same-UID mutation between observations is not mechanically excluded.
v1.0.3 aggregate promotion contracts are synthetic 43/43 evidence and invoke the production certifier CLI for the baseline and every negative; they do not authenticate a real runtime.

v1.0.3 certify_pass_tracked_upgrade.py caps every complete modeled result at PASS-SCOPED/CAPPED with promotion_authorized false, promotion-contract-v2-complete, both unresolved Issue #5 obligations, and nonzero exit; generic ntt_gate.py PASS-TRACKED semantics remain unchanged, while the formal runner separately caps an otherwise PASS-TRACKED result at PASS-SCOPED because temporal immutability is not mechanically enforced; unavailable process containment fails before execution rather than creating a scoped run.

v1.0.3 Slice G binds each fixture to a distinct byte-hashed transcript and canonical prompt/fixture/artifact tuple, independently derives package inventory and exclusion policy from the current validator, and reruns basic package validation unconditionally for promotion.

v1.0.3 Slice H records the shared stable-tree digest, exact evals.json digest, each artifact-byte digest, and invocation config at live-run start; promotion recomputes every byte binding and requires exact normalized ordered preflight and fixture argv without extras.

v1.0.3 CI policy uses a dependency-free restricted YAML subset and requires the exact triggers, top-level contents: read permission, single job, SHA-pinned ordered actions, and run scripts; the unpacked Git archive must run the exact full --self-test with Markdown outside the archive before its promotion aggregate, and comments or uncalled functions cannot satisfy that command; extra triggers, permissions, jobs, steps, uses, environment, mutable action tags, or unsupported YAML syntax fail closed.

v1.0.3 eval fixtures use unique canonical lowercase ASCII slug IDs of 8 through 128 characters and an exact unique closed artifact set of canonical relative POSIX regular files, so transcript names and artifact paths cannot escape their roots.

v1.0.3 release-lock stable-tree validation binds the actual outer --self-test with complete no-follow non-cruft entry/type/mode/hardlink/byte snapshots, then invokes two literal deterministic CLI passes with unique external outputs; optional tools, live runtime evaluation, and caller evidence are explicit scope exclusions rather than simulated equivalents.
v1.0.3 RELEASE_LOCK required_commands is a unique ordered string list bound to the reviewed canonical SHA-256; extra or substituted manual executable commands fail closed even after manifest refresh.

github_readme_documentation.policy: GitHub-facing README files are allowed under docs/ and self_validation/ but not inside plugin-loadable runtime component directories.
github_readme_documentation.runtime_surface_effect: documentation-only; does not add skills, agents, hooks, commands, MCP servers, monitors, bins, or tool grants

notes: This package is team/internal scoped. It catches accidental and ordinary team-reuse drift rather than proving against a fully hostile maintainer who can rewrite all validators and manifests.

This is a deliberately closed-surface package validator, not a general Claude Code plugin-surface validator; hooks, MCP/LSP servers, commands, monitors, bins, manifest component-path fields, and dynamic skill shell remain forbidden even where the broader platform may support them.

Runtime-surface expansion through plugin.json component fields, hooks, MCP/LSP configs, monitors, settings, commands, bins, dynamic skill shell, or broad allowed-tools must fail unless the team explicitly changes this policy and adds corresponding tests.
PASS-SCOPED is the v1.0.3 release status: live Claude Code fixture transcripts remain necessary, and certify_pass_tracked_upgrade.py also retains the mandatory two-obligation Issue #5 cap.
Formal artifact invocation requires ntt-formal-coordinator, native ntt-* lanes, certificate JSON, ntt_gate.py output, invocation ledger, and transcript evidence.
PASS-TRACKED requires trace-authenticated native Agent/Task tool-use events for every required ntt-* lane; a ledger assertion alone is insufficient.

Strict local evidence requires every cited evidence_ref itself to resolve to an in-root JSON file and every structured artifact_path hash_or_version binding to match exactly; one valid ref cannot mask a bad cited ref.
STABLE_RELEASE_MANIFEST.json is a release-integrity artifact: it inventories package files except itself and carries a canonical self-hash over its JSON content with self_hash_sha256 set to null.
AUDIT_REPORT.md is a non-runtime audit artifact. It is allowed at top level but must remain covered by STABLE_RELEASE_MANIFEST.json.
Release-lock commands are required to be idempotent: after they run on a fresh copy with README.md as target, validate_package.py . must still pass against STABLE_RELEASE_MANIFEST.json.

Formal trace authentication rejects text-only, implicit-name, mismatched-result-id, duplicate-id, nested-fake-result, result-before-call, empty-result, and generic-result transcripts; PASS-TRACKED requires separate successful result/completion events bound to exact native tool-use ids.
Strict local evidence treats URI schemes case-insensitively and rejects any non-empty scheme in evidence_refs; uppercase HTTPS, DOI, URN, and scheme-like refs are not local provenance.
Formal trace authentication parses only recognized stream-json event positions; fake tool_result dictionaries nested inside tool inputs or arguments cannot authenticate PASS-TRACKED.
Formal trace authentication requires result/completion events to occur after their matching tool-use events.
Strict local evidence mode rejects every URI-scheme evidence ref case-insensitively, including HTTPS://, DOI:, URN:, and arbitrary scheme-like refs.

v1.0.3 formal trace authentication treats recognized stream-json positions as necessary but not sufficient: event type must be an authentic tool_use/tool_result style type, so text/message/assistant blocks cannot masquerade as native Agent/Task calls or results.
Unexpected native Agent/Task tool-use events without exact required ntt-* structured selectors are flagged and prevent PASS-TRACKED promotion.
Strict local evidence rejects URI-scheme values in both evidence_refs and artifact_path, regardless of URI scheme case.
v1.0.3 formal trace authentication rejects data/payload/delta event smuggling under tool_result events and rejects role-inverted tool_use/tool_result message directions.
v1.0.3 strict evidence gating requires modal tests to target their evaluated claim and carry stable nonempty IDs; wildcard evidence applicability cannot substitute for a missing test ID.

v1.0.3 adds a fixed-pattern release-time provenance hygiene guard over bundled audit/self-validation artifacts so configured stale ledgers and known machine-local build/workspace roots cannot masquerade as current release evidence.

Raw external runtime transcripts may retain truthful resolved tool paths; bundled runtime summaries recursively normalize exact executable, package-root, and output-directory display values and label the command representation as normalized display rather than literal argv.
v1.0.3 adds a no-automatic-epistemic-closure certificate rule: downstream/deployment/safety/action claims do not inherit pass status from source claims and must be separately represented and tested.

v1.0.3 adds a promotion-contract-v2 audit path with fresh deterministic suites, fresh allowlisted official validators, formal result 2.0, typed promotion-evidence-v2 roles, a nonempty canonically evaluated claim set, and explicit downstream_review; text captures do not authorize and absent official tools scope only through the explicit flag without removing either official policy role or changing the canonical DAG.
v1.0.3 adds a GitHub-ready README documentation tree under docs/ while preserving the closed runtime surface and forbidding README files inside plugin-loadable component directories.

Current live-runtime evidence records executable SHA-256 and version output as observational provenance only; authentication_status=observed-not-cryptographically-authenticated explicitly withholds any claim that the binary is an official build.

PASS-TRACKED promotion independently executes the current validator inventory policy and requires the stable manifest path set and volatile exclusion arrays to match it exactly; manifest-authored exclusions cannot hide behavior files.

PASS-TRACKED promotion accepts only the exact ntt-stable-release-tree-v1 package_tree_sha256 computed after stable-manifest self-hash and actual path/hash/byte verification; package_sha256 aliases are ignored.

Promotion v2 rejects legacy flat evidence_refs. Its fixed typed canonical role DAG binds exact bundle-local regular non-symlink file bytes and SHA-256, rejects path/file aliases, permits equal bytes across distinct semantic roles, and keeps both official policy nodes under explicit unavailable-tool scope exclusion.

Promotion v2 rejects non-object, null, boolean-aliased, duplicate-ID, invalid-ID, and empty claim sets as INVALID_INPUT; every accepted claim is independently evaluated through the canonical gate before downstream review.

Official Claude validation uses exact ordered argv ending in --strict and accepts the real ANSI-normalized Validation passed form only when complete stdout/stderr contain no failure or contradiction; the formal runner likewise binds the complete transcript rather than a tail.

Caller-controlled certifier and formal destinations are lstat-checked component by component; unsafe ancestors/targets fail structurally, while an explicitly supplied existing private regular --json file uses same-directory exclusive temporary plus atomic replacement.

Current promotion-v2 provenance is recorded separately in self_validation/evidence/C-pass-tracked-upgrade-audit__aggregate-certifier.json and self_validation/evidence/C-pass-tracked-upgrade-audit__promotion-v2-reference.json; the executable contract is skills/nozickian-verify/scripts/run_promotion_certifier_contract_tests.py.

PASS-TRACKED promotion rejects stale live results after package, evals.json, artifact, or non-artifact behavior-source changes even when manifests are refreshed; it also rejects prompt-only, missing-plugin-dir, wrong-format, wrong-max-turns, extra-arg, swapped-order, and wrong-preflight normalized argv.
v1.0.1_evidence_hardening: Strict local evidence mode counts unique canonical evidence and modal tests, rejects URI-scheme refs/artifact paths, requires modal tests to have stable IDs and target the evaluated claim, and release validation now rejects stale generated artifact provenance.
v1.0.1_patch_notes: Regenerate bundled self-validation ledgers for the current package version rather than carrying stale prior-version outputs.

Add validate_package.py fixed-pattern release-provenance hygiene checks for stale generated artifact tokens, old package-root names, and known machine-local build/workspace roots in release/audit/self-validation artifacts.
Add a nearby-false-world mutation that injects stale self-validation provenance and requires the package validator to reject it.
Document the closed-surface design more explicitly: this validator intentionally rejects plugin runtime surfaces outside the team/internal threat model even when the platform may support them.
Preserve PASS-SCOPED release label until live official Claude Code runtime stream-json traces and optional official validators are available.
Add first-class PASS-TRACKED upgrade audit instructions and a promotion certifier script while preserving PASS-SCOPED as this release artifact status.
v1.0.1_trace_authentication_hardening: Strict formal trace authentication uses hard event boundaries for tool events, exact structured ntt-* selectors, post-call matching result IDs, role-aware message direction when available, no unexpected Agent/Task calls, and substantive nonempty result content.
